items.title: Kyle Monangai: Questionable for Sunday
items.text:
Monangai (thumb/toe) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Buccaneers.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Denzel Boston: Cleared for Sunday
items.text:
Boston (calf) was a full participant in Friday's practice and doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game at New Orleans, Chris Easterling of the Akron Beacon Journal reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: DJ Moore: Wears non-contact jersey Friday
items.text:
Moore (shoulder) was still wearing a non-contact jersey at Friday's practice, Sal Capaccio of WGR Sports Radio 550 Buffalo reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Dalton Kincaid: Ditches non-contact jersey
items.text:
Kincaid (chest) is no longer in a red non-contact jersey at Friday's practice, Sal Capaccio of WGR Sports Radio 550 Buffalo reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Malik Nabers: 'Full go' for Week 9
items.text:
Head coach John Harbaugh said Nabers (knee) "practiced fully" Friday and will be "full go" for Sunday's game at Philadelphia, Matt Citak of the Giants' official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
